name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Amirrudin Bin Kamsin
title: Associate Professor / Head of Department
bio: Leading Malaysian academic and Head of Department at FCSIT, Universiti Malaya. Expert in HCI, Educational Technology, and Islamic Informatics with over 100 high-impact publications and RM 3.6 million in research funding.

name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Ang Tan Fong
title: Associate Professor / Deputy Dean
bio: Specializes in Cloud Computing and Grid Computing. Serves as Deputy Dean of Higher Degree and has received multiple Excellence Service Awards. PhD in Grid Computing from Universiti Malaya.

name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Kasturi Dewi Varathan
title: Associate Professor
bio: Expert in data analytics and text mining with awards in international innovation competitions. Former visiting scientist at University of Lugano, Switzerland. Recipient of grants from ETH Zurich and MOHE.

name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Ling Teck Chaw
title: Associate Professor
bio: Specializes in Cloud Infrastructure and SDN. Cisco Networking Academy Expert Level Instructor with senior faculty administrative experience. PhD from Universiti Malaya.

name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Maizatul Akmar Binti Ismail
title: Associate Professor
bio: Expert in predictive modeling and recommender systems. Associate Editor for the Malaysian Journal of Computer Science and recipient of numerous national innovation awards.

name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Mohamad Nizam Bin Ayub
title: Associate Professor
bio: Focuses on Data Visualisation and E-games. PhD in Multimedia from the University of the West of Scotland. Experienced coordinator within the faculty.

name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Nor Aniza Binti Abdullah
title: Associate Professor
bio: Expert in personalized e-learning and medical image processing. Former Deputy Dean and PhD holder from Southampton University, UK.

name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Norisma Binti Idris
title: Associate Professor / Dean
bio: Current Dean of FCSIT. Leading expert in NLP and AI with numerous service excellence and innovation awards.

name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Norjihan Binti Abdul Ghani
title: Associate Professor
bio: Specializes in information security and data protection. Experienced in curriculum development for IT management. PhD from Universiti Teknologi Malaysia.

name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Raja Jamilah Binti Raja Yusof
title: Associate Professor
bio: Expert in UX and Agile development. Senior Member of IEEE and ACM myHCI-UX. Specialist in Quranic applications and computational thinking.

name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Rosli Bin Salleh
title: Associate Professor
bio: Expert in Computer Networks and cybersecurity with a PhD from Salford University, UK. Specialized in SDN and malware detection.

name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Saaidal Razalli Bin Azzuhri
title: Associate Professor / Deputy Dean
bio: Deputy Dean of Research & Innovation and founder of the university's Blockchain Technology Lab. PhD from the University of Queensland.

name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Suraya Binti Hamid
title: Associate Professor
bio: Former Head of Information Systems with a PhD from the University of Melbourne. Focused on social informatics and e-learning impact.

name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Tey Kok Soon
title: Associate Professor

name: Assoc. Prof. Ts. Dr. Ismail Bin Ahmedy
title: Associate Professor
bio: Head of the Center for Mobile Cloud Computing Research (C4MCCR). Specialist in WSN and communication protocols.

name: Assoc. Prof. Ts. Dr. Mumtaz Begum Binti Peer Mustafa
title: Associate Professor
bio: Expert in speech enhancement and assistive technologies for speech-impaired individuals. Certified software tester.

name: Assoc. Prof. Ts. Dr. Aznul Qalid bin Md Sabri
title: Associate Professor
bio: Former Director of UMCIE and Head of AI. Expert in human action recognition and healthcare vision applications.

name: Datin Prof. Dr. Sameem Binti Abdul Kareem
title: Honorary Professor
bio: Distinguished academic with over 30 years in AI and Medical Informatics. Former Deputy Dean and Editor-in-Chief of MJCS.

name: Dr. Abdelhak Lekbir
title: Post Doctoral Research Fellow
bio: Post Doctoral Fellow at CST Department. PhD in Electrical Engineering from UTeM.

name: Dr. Adeleh Asemi Zavareh
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Expert in intelligent decision support systems using AI and IoT. PhD in AI from Universiti Malaya with over a decade of experience.

name: Dr. Asmiza Binti Abdul Sani
title: Senior Lecturer / Head of Department
bio: Head of Software Engineering. Specialist in model-driven engineering and real-time systems for robotics. PhD from York University, UK.

name: Dr. Bryan Raj A/L Peter Jabaraj
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Certified Microsoft Azure Administrator. Focused on WSN optimization and metaheuristic algorithms for precision agriculture.

name: Dr. Burhan Ul Islam Khan
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Expert in encryption standards and blockchain architectures for secure IoT communications. Extensive work in MANET security.

name: Dr. Chiam Yin Kia
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: PhD from UNSW Australia. Specialized in empirical software engineering and healthcare AI, focusing on cardiac rehabilitation models.

name: Dr. Eke Christopher Ifeanyi
title: Post Doctoral Research Fellow
bio: Post Doctoral Fellow in Information Systems. PhD in Computer Science from Universiti Malaya.

name: Dr. Erma Rahayu Binti Mohd Faizal Abdullah
title: Senior Lecturer / Deputy Dean
bio: Deputy Dean of Student Affairs. Expert in responsible AI and healthcare computer vision (UMFit). IEEE CertifAIEd™ Authorized Assessor.

name: Dr. Hema A/P Subramaniam
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Specializes in green software engineering and mental health analytics. PhD from UPM. Focuses on sustainability and usability.

name: Dr. Hoo Wai Lam
title: Senior Lecturer / Head of Department
bio: Head of Information System. Expert in zero-shot object recognition and pattern recognition. Former President of IEEE CIS Malaysia.

name: Dr. Liew Wei Shiung
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Focused on explainable goal-driven agents and robotic vision. PhD in Computer Science & Mathematics from Universiti Malaya.

name: Dr. Lim Chee Kau
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Expert in fuzzy relational theory and interval-valued inferencing for medical diagnosis. Specialist in scene classification.

name: Dr. Mohamed N. M. Lubani
title: Lecturer
bio: Focused on intent-aware semantic search and knowledge graphs. PhD from UKM.

name: Dr. Muhammad Nur Firdaus Bin Sahran
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Expert in SDN and protocol-driven agentic AI for autonomous threat response. PhD from Universiti Malaya.

name: Dr. Muhammad Shahreeza Safiruz Bin Kassim
title: Senior Lecturer / Head of Department
bio: Head of AI Department. Expert in biophysics modeling and applying probabilistic machine learning to biological systems. PhD from Southampton, UK.

name: Dr. Narsimlu Kemsaram
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: IEEE Senior Member specializing in AI-enabled autonomy for multi-robot systems and UAVs. Extensive experience in space robotics and planetary exploration.

name: Dr. Nazean Binti Jomhari
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Expert in designing interactive apps for people with special needs. Specialist in Quranic research for children with disabilities. PhD from Manchester, UK.

name: Dr. Nur Nasuha Binti Mohd Daud
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Specialist in link prediction and knowledge graph modeling for medical data and socio-technical domains. PhD from Universiti Malaya.

name: Dr. Nurul Binti Japar
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Expert in visual recognition and object detection. Head of Training at CITRA UM and IEEE CertifAIEd Authorized Assessor.

name: Dr. Nurul Fazmidar Binti Mohd Noor
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Expert in affective interface design and gamification for education. PhD from Lancaster University, UK. Specialist in VR collaborative environments.

name: Dr. Ong Sim Ying
title: Senior Lecturer / Deputy Dean
bio: Deputy Dean of Higher Degree. Expert in reversible data embedding and multimedia usability. IEEE SPS Malaysia Research Excellence Award recipient.

name: Dr. Rasha R. J. Ataallah
title: Lecturer
bio: Expert in deep learning for healthcare and facial biometrics. Experienced trainer with strong presentation skills in translating complex technology concepts.

name: Dr. Saw Shier Nee
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Expert in Biomedical Engineering and AI for clinical detection (oral cancer). Focused on LLMs and RAG for clinical chatbots. PhD from NUS.

name: Dr. Shapla Khanam
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Leading academic in IoT security using deep learning. Chair of IEEE WIE UM. Former Application Engineer at Atlassian.

name: Dr. Su Moon Ting
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Programme Coordinator for MSE (Software Technology). Expert in software technology education and computational thinking games. PhD from Auckland.

name: Dr. Suzan Jabbar Obaiys
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Specialist in mathematics for quantum theory and algorithm complexity. PhD from UPM. Focused on digital security algorithms.

name: Dr. Unaizah Hanum Binti Obaidellah
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Specialist in AI for cognition and computer perception. Focused on medical image processing and accessible education. PhD from Sussex, UK.

name: Dr. Uzair Iqbal
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Expert in smart healthcare systems and AutoLLM for software defect prediction. Specialist in multi-agent cardiac MRI analysis.

name: Dr. Uzair Ishtiaq
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Specialist in explainable deep learning models for diabetic retinopathy and vision model stability. Over 10 years of experience.

name: Dr. Woo Chaw Seng
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Former Head of AI Department. Expert in image processing with a granted patent. Extensive experience in academic management and postgraduate supervision.

name: Dr. Zainab Malik
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Expert in human action interpretation using CNNs and key flow frame selection for video classification. PhD from UTM.

name: Dr. Zati Hakim Binti Azizul Hasan
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Leading expert in AI robotics and swarm optimization. Recipient of RM8.5 million MOHE grant for AI robotics teaching. Coordinator at Pusat Teknologi Inovasi.

name: Prof. Dr. Mohd Yamani Idna Bin Idris
title: Professor
bio: Distinguished Professor and former Deputy Dean with expertise in IoT and Computer Vision. Recognized as one of Stanford's Top 2% Scientists in 2024 and 2025. Successfully supervised 25 PhD candidates and actively involved in national digitalization initiatives.

name: Prof. Dr. Nor Liyana Mohd Shuib
title: Professor
bio: Global Top 2% scientist specialized in personalization and recommender systems. Coordinates the Bachelor of Computer Science (Data Science) program. Leading innovator with over 30 prestigious national and international awards.

name: Prof. Dr. Por Lip Yee @ Por Khoon Sun
title: Professor
bio: IEEE Senior Member and security expert focused on AI applications for medical diagnostics and decentralized healthcare security. Has secured more than RM 7 million in research funding as Principal Investigator.

name: Prof. Dr. Siti Hafizah Binti Ab Hamid
title: Professor
bio: Deputy Dean of Development and expert in software quality and affective computing. Graduated over 15 PhD and 20 Master students. Leading researcher in AI-based software applications and mental health analytics.

name: Prof. Dr. Teh Ying Wah
title: Professor
bio: Highly accomplished data mining expert with over 35 years of experience. Former Quality Manager and Head of Department. Has produced top-tier data scientists currently working at IBM, Amazon, and Google.

name: Prof. Ts. Dr. Ainuddin Wahid Bin Abdul Wahab
title: Professor
bio: Executive Director and leading academic in multimedia networks and digital forensics. Recipient of multiple gold and silver medals at international invention fairs including ITEX and Seoul International Invention Fair.

name: Prof. Ts. Dr. Nor Badrul Anuar Bin Juma'at
title: Professor
bio: Director of CSNET and world Top 2% scientist. Former Associate Vice Chancellor (Infrastructure and Information Services) and CIO of UM. Extensive supervision record including 22 PhD and 10 research Master students.

name: Prof. Ts. Dr. Rafidah Binti Md Noor
title: Professor
bio: Expert in ITS and mobile computing with a PhD from Lancaster University. Former Director of QMEC and Head of Department. Successfully secured over RM 2.5 million in grants and holds a patent for traffic congestion relief.

name: Prof. Ts. Dr. Sri Devi A/P Ravana
title: Professor
bio: Director of the Centre for Integral Learning (CITRA) and expert in IR evaluation. PhD from the University of Melbourne. Active international collaborator with universities in Hong Kong, NZ, Australia, and the UK.

name: Prof. Ts. Dr. Vimala A/P Balakrishnan
title: Professor
bio: Distinguished interdisciplinary researcher ranked among the Top 2% scientists worldwide. Leads research in machine learning applied to societal and healthcare issues. Fulbright Research Scholar with over RM 4 million in grants.

name: Prof. Ir. Dr. Chan Chee Seng
title: Professor
bio: Full Professor and leading expert in computer vision and machine learning. Recognized as a Top Research Scientist in Malaysia (2022) and has secured over RM 3M in research funding. Previously served as Undersecretary at the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MOSTI).

name: Dr. Fairuz Amalina Binti Narudin
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Senior Lecturer specialized in data security and digital privacy with a PhD from Universiti Malaya. Her research focuses on machine learning applications for malware detection and big data analytics challenges.

name: Ts. Dr. Mohamad Hazim Bin Md Hanif
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: PhD holder from Imperial College London specializing in the intersection of computer security and artificial intelligence. Serves as the Coordinator of the Data Intensive Computing Centre (DICC) and is a core member of CSNET.

name: Ts. Dr. Mohd Shahrul Nizam Bin Mohd Danuri
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Senior Lecturer and Coordinator of the Master in Data Science program. Expert in ICT applications for agriculture and a registered Professional Technologist with over 14 years of industry experience.

name: Ts. Dr. Muhammad Faiz Bin Mohd Zaki
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Director of the Data and Information Management Center with a PhD in Network Analytics from Universiti Malaya. Leading researcher in real-time network traffic classification and federated learning architectures.

name: Ts. Dr. Siti Nurliana Binti Jamalai@Jamali
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Senior Lecturer in Software Engineering specializing in human-centred solutions and tangible user interfaces for inclusive learning. Her research focuses on improving accessibility and learning experiences for diverse users.

name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Tutut Herawan
title: Associate Professor
bio: Associate Professor and world Top 2% Scientist ranking according to Stanford University. A highly prolific author with over 345 articles and 19 years of academic experience, specializing in big data management and soft computing.

name: Dr. Lee Sai Peck
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Senior Lecturer specializing in software testing, requirements engineering, and agile methodologies. Active contributor to empirical software engineering research with a focus on software quality assurance and verification.

name: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Masnizah Mohd
title: Associate Professor
bio: Associate Professor with expertise in information retrieval and digital library systems. Specialist in text mining and knowledge organization with extensive publication record in information science journals. PhD from Universiti Malaya.

name: Dr. Norshahriah binti Abdul Wahab
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Senior Lecturer in Software Engineering with a focus on model-based software testing and cloud-based software quality. PhD from Universiti Malaya. Experienced in supervising industry-oriented software projects.

name: Dr. Aamir Shafi
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Senior Lecturer specializing in blockchain architecture, smart contracts, and decentralized application development. Expert in consensus protocol design and distributed ledger security for real-world deployment scenarios.

name: Dr. Khairana Khairudin
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Senior Lecturer in Software Engineering specializing in mutation testing and search-based software engineering. PhD research focused on automated test case generation. Experienced in undergraduate and postgraduate supervision.

name: Dr. Azlin Nordin
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Senior Lecturer in Information Systems with a specialization in health informatics and clinical decision support systems. Focuses on the integration of AI into electronic health record systems and patient outcome prediction. PhD from Universiti Malaya.

name: Dr. Tan Choo Jun
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Senior Lecturer specializing in autonomous robotics and swarm intelligence. Expert in evolutionary computation applied to multi-robot coordination and soft computing-based decision making. PhD in Computer Science from Universiti Malaya.

name: Dr. Mohd Nor Akmal Khalid
title: Senior Lecturer
bio: Senior Lecturer specializing in speech and audio signal processing with applications in voice recognition systems and affective computing. Active researcher in multilingual speech technology for Malaysian languages. PhD from Universiti Malaya.
